stats.notes: From the Common Data Set: totals for fall 2025 first-time, first-year students (men 1,681 + women 3,123 applied; 1,586 + 2,916 admitted; 255 + 404 enrolled). Bellarmine did not report the residency split of applicants and admits (including international), so no international admit rate is shown; 11 of the 659 enrolled first-years were nonresidents. The GPA breakdown is for all enrolled students. Undergraduate enrollment is 2,365 (all undergraduates); international undergraduates number 48 (the nonresident count in that total). Early decision: none; early action: yes. No waitlist data reported. Test-optional.

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set: SAT/ACT scores are used in admission decisions if submitted but not required (and used for advising).

cost.notes: First-year and all-undergraduate costs from the Common Data Set (2026-27): tuition 50,660; required fees 1,600; food and housing 11,770 (housing 5,890 + meals 5,880); books 500; residential transportation 1,080 is not included in other costs. Non-need-based aid from the college is available to nonresidents; 40 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received aid from the college, average 45,317 (total 1,812,685); to apply for this aid, the college asks them only for an International Student's Certification of Finances
